|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 (version 2 of 4), the PC website card list text (21 July 2012 to 11 January 2013). It is not the current text. The current text is [[Prophetess (V) (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3): the Master List of 27 April 2013. No published image shows this text, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of it ([[:File:VB1-17-Prophetess-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]]).
* '''Original''' ([[Prophetess (V)]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 1 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009).<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock1.pdf#page=2 Virtual Block 1 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"), page 2, slip 17. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020181626/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock1.pdf#page=2 Internet Archive]</ref> Full text: “Deploys -1 and forfeit +3 at a site. Once per turn, may peek at top card of opponent's Reserve Deck or Used Pile; may then shuffle that Reserve Deck or Used Pile. Immune to attrition < 3.” Document: the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB1-17-Prophetess.png]]) prints slip number “17” bottom right.
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text) changed “Deploys -1 and” to “Deploy -1 and”.<ref name="cl-1210_17-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock1Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064706/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock1Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive)</ref> Full text: “Deploy -1 and forfeit +3 at a site. Once per turn, may peek at top card of opponent's Reserve Deck or Used Pile; may then shuffle that Reserve Deck or Used Pile. Immune to attrition < 3.” The PC website card list was generated from the Players Committee's Holotable card data (research R7, 11 November 2026), so its wording follows that data; it is listed as a version because the PC published it.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Prophetess (V) (Errata 2)]]): Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB1-D-prophetess-pre.gif]]), on the PC website by 25 February 2013 (server upload date)<ref name="pcimg-Virtual1-Dark">Players Committee card image, file <code>cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual1-Dark/large/prophetess.gif</code>; the directory listing of this folder (Virtual1-Dark) was not captured; the captured Legacy folders (Virtual2, Virtual4, Virtual5, Virtual6, Virtual7) all carry 25-Feb-2013 11:33/11:34, the date the PC rebuilt its image set (research R6, 11 November 2026: these are bulk upload dates, and an image may have been made earlier). Today's copy: https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/legacy/VirtualBlock1-Dark/large/prophetess.gif</ref>: “Deploys -1 and forfeit +3 at a site. Once per turn, may peek at top card of opponent's Reserve Deck or Used Pile; may then shuffle that Reserve Deck or Used Pile. Immune to attrition < 3.” '''What changed:''' the PC card image prints the original release-sheet text of 7 December 2009 again, word for word, after the PC website card list (PC-E1) had published a different text. It is listed as its own version, placed at its upload date (Bill's rulings of 11 November 2026: a PC card image is its own version, placed at its date (here its server upload date), even when its words repeat an earlier version; whatever was published last is current). The date is only the folder's bulk upload date: the image may have been made earlier, so its place in the order is uncertain, but the versioning order follows the upload date. Document: the PC card image is a whole card (art, title bar, lore, icons, frame and the Virtual Block 1 set mark) and prints the number “17” bottom right, as the release-sheet slip does.
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Prophetess (V) (Errata 3)]]): Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side p. 13), official text as of 27 April 2013<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=13, page 13. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=13 Internet Archive]</ref>: “Deploys -1 and forfeit +3 at a site. Once per turn, may peek at top card of opponent's Reserve Deck or Used Pile; may then shuffle that Reserve Deck or Used Pile. Immune to attrition < 3.” '''What changed:''' the Master List prints the original release-sheet text of 7 December 2009 again, word for word. It is the last publication, so it is the current text; it is listed as its own version because it was published (Bill's rulings of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even one that repeats an earlier text word for word; whatever was published last is current). The image on its page is the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1210-17-master.png]]). Document: the Master List slip prints no slip number.
